Patient was apparently normal 30 days back when he developed B/L upper limb and lower limb weakness sudden in onset, progressive in nature, with c/o difficulty in buttoning & unbuttoning with Left upper limb (distal muscle). No c/o difficulty in gripping chappals, No c/o difficulty in combing hair or difficulty in getting up from squatting (proximal weakness). No c/o rolling over bed, getting up from bed, No c/o raising head & holding neck. c/o: urinary urgency with incontinence occasionally sudden in onset, progressive in nature for 20 days.
Also c/o easy fatigability for 20 days sudden in onset, progressive in nature. 
c/o fever for 1 day sudden in onset, low grade, no night sweats/chills & rigors. 
No c/o involuntary movements, stiffening of limb. 
No c/o disturbance of smell, visual disturbance. 
No h/o diplopia, ptosis, difficulty in eating, unable to feel sensation over face. 
No h/o drooling of saliva, deviation of angle of mouth, inability to close eyes, loss of taste sensation, disturbance in hearing, vertigo/tinnitus. 
No h/o nasal regurgitation of feeds, difficulty in swallowing, difficulty in turning head side to side. 
No c/o sensory disturbance, bowel incontinence/constipation. 
No c/o headache, vomiting, blurring of vision. 
No h/o trauma, convulsions, loss of appetite.
